description: Unified dataset combining formulas, feature metadata, metrics, validations, and patient-level predictions from the Dempster-Shafer clinical fusion model. Free of DL fields.

4_loss_function.formula: L(beta) = -(1/n) * sum_i w_i [y_i * log(sigma(s_i)) + (1-y_i) * log(1-sigma(s_i))] + (1/C) * [l1 * sum_j * sqrt(beta_j^2 + eps) + (1-l1)/2 * sum_j * beta_j^2]
4_loss_function.class_weights: w_i = n/(2*n1) if y_i=1 else n/(2*n0)  [balanced]

6_calibration.fitted_on: training fold, applied on test fold (no leakage)

alpha2.name: Model-Quality Geometric Score
alpha2.formula: alpha2 = [max(eps,MCC_n)^w1 * max(eps,GMean)^w2 * max(eps,BSS)^w3 * max(eps,1-ECE)^w4] * S_cv^eta * max(eps,Phi)^lambda

common_alpha.name: Murphy-Dempster Hybrid Evidence Fusion
common_alpha.final_calibration: alpha_common = clip(IsotonicRegression(alpha_common_raw), eps, 1-eps)  [Out-of-Fold Stratified 10-Fold CV applied to prevent leakage]
common_alpha.calibration: Out-of-Fold 10-Split Stratified Isotonic Regression applied to raw fused score, clipped to [0.0001, 0.9999]

alpha2_results.note: alpha2 recomputed on 2026-06-15; differs from prior versions (e.g. 0.480286) due to standardizing the constant feature VCS and switching to Stratified 10-Fold CV out-of-fold metrics.

correlation_scores.description: Pearson r and Spearman rho between all 31 augmented features + 3 scores and the cardio target

alpha1_vs_cardio.interpretation: Strong monotonic agreement with true CVD label

alpha2_vs_cardio.note: Alpha2 is a single model-quality scalar, not a per-patient vector — per-patient correlation is N/A by design
alpha2_vs_cardio.interpretation: Represents overall model performance quality on [0,1] scale

common_alpha_vs_cardio.interpretation: Highest of all three scores — fusion improves discriminability

overall_calibrated_metrics.pipeline_status: Wearable DL pipeline dropped due to low performance (AUC 0.49). Fused clinical scorers remain.
